name: Open professional tennis match data
publisher: Jeff Sackmann (Match Charting Project) and the Tennismylife community
description: Match-level and point-level results for professional tennis, distributed as CSVs in git. Jeff Sackmann's tennis_atp and tennis_wta - the datasets almost every tennis analytics project has been built on - were 404 on 2026-09-06; his Match Charting Project, with point-by-point data for thousands of charted matches, is alive and was updated the same day. Tennismylife/TML-Database carries ATP results from 1968 to the present in Sackmann's own column layout.

license.name: Match Charting Project is CC-BY-NC-SA 4.0; TML-Database states no explicit licence
license.redistribution: MCP: non-commercial with attribution and share-alike. TML: unstated, so ask before republishing.

access.size_hint: charting-m-points-2020s.csv is tens of MB; one TML year file is under 1 MB
access.etiquette: clone the repo once rather than fetching raw files in a loop

fields: TML: tourney_id, surface, tourney_level, winner_name, loser_name, winner_rank, score, w_ace, w_df, w_svpt ...
MCP: charting-m-points-*.csv has one row per point with a shot-by-shot notation string

probes.description: ATP results for the current season
The canonical dataset almost every tennis project cites
probes.known_broken: 404 on 2026-09-06, as are tennis_wta, tennis_slam_pointbypoint and tennis_pointbypoint. Only tennis_MatchChartingProject remains under that account. Thousands of tutorials, papers and notebooks point at these URLs.

recipes.title: Every match a player won this season
recipes.code:
curl -s https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tennismylife/TML-Database/master/2026.csv \
 | python3 -c "import csv,sys;[print(r['tourney_name'], r['round'], r['loser_name'], r['score']) for r in csv.DictReader(sys.stdin) if 'Sinner' in r['winner_name']]" | head

gotchas.trap: Any code or tutorial fetching raw.githubusercontent.com/JeffSackmann/tennis_atp/... breaks today. The failure is a 404 on a raw URL, which is easy to misread as a typo.
gotchas.fix: Use Tennismylife/TML-Database for ATP match results - same column layout - and check for an archived copy before assuming the history is lost.

gotchas.trap: The Match Charting Project is crowd-charted, so coverage is deep but not representative: big matches are over-sampled.
gotchas.fix: Do not treat it as a random sample of professional tennis.

see_also.note: ATP 1968-present in Sackmann's schema, updated weekly
